description: The LinkedIn profile of the person behind any X (Twitter) handle, not just the user's own. Use when they give an @handle or an x.com link and ask for that person's LinkedIn, or who they are professionally. Pass context (who they likely are, e.g. 'VC at a16z') when the handle could belong to several people. confidence is out of 10; present linkedin_url as a match only when confident is true, and otherwise say it is a guess or that no match was found.

context.description: Optional hint about who the person is, to tell apart common handles.

handle.description: The X handle, with or without @, or an x.com / twitter.com profile URL.

name: find_linkedin_from_x_handle
title: Find LinkedIn from X handle
